WITH telescope_weather_groups AS (
  SELECT t.telescregistry, o.weathprofile, AVG(s.modindex) as avg_modindex, AVG(s.phaseshiftdeg) as avg_phaseshift
  FROM signals s
  JOIN telescopes t ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry
  JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation
  GROUP BY t.telescregistry, o.weathprofile
),
baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(s.modindex) as baseline_modindex
  FROM signals s
  JOIN telescopes t ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry
  JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation
),
kept_groups AS (
  SELECT twg.weathprofile, twg.avg_modindex, twg.avg_phaseshift, (twg.avg_modindex - b.baseline_modindex) as excess
  FROM telescope_weather_groups twg, baseline b
  WHERE twg.avg_modindex > b.baseline_modindex
)
SELECT weathprofile,
       AVG(avg_modindex) as avg_modindex_of_kept,
       AVG(avg_phaseshift) as avg_phaseshift_of_kept,
       AVG(excess) as avg_excess
FROM kept_groups
GROUP BY weathprofile
ORDER BY weathprofile
